name: extract-todos
setup:
printf '# app
# TODO: add logging
def main():
    pass  # TODO: implement
' > app.py
prompt: Collect every TODO comment in app.py into a new file TODO.md, one bullet per TODO (keep the text after 'TODO:'). Do not modify app.py.
verify: grep -q 'add logging' TODO.md && grep -q 'implement' TODO.md && grep -q 'TODO: add logging' app.py && grep -q 'TODO: implement' app.py
